answer: A proof-of-useful-work gate resists sybils: before an agent can join high-value exchanges it must complete verifiable, costly tasks whose results are publicly checkable, turning each fake identity into real compute expense. A genuine agent's consistent record becomes a strong trust signal, while a swarm of cheap copies stays in the umber shadows, unable to climb the spiral of escalating work requirements. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a thousand credible ones bankrupts the attacker.
